source: SkiEssentials 2027 Ski Test (skiessentials.com), Men's Frontside and Men's All-Mountain categories
measured_fields: radius (when the site lists a single value)
interpretation_method: Every interpreted field is a fixed formula built from the measured tester-score averages and the site's own stated specs/tags (terrain, ability level, mid width, radius) - never a per-ski free-form guess. A small set of keyword checks (carving/precision language, smooth-damp vs chatter-harsh language) adjusts carvingPrecision and smoothness by +/-0.3, based only on short local review fragments that are never copied into this app. Full formulas are documented per-ski in local/ratings_notes.json (not deployed).
notes: The 165-row Jonas_master_ski_sheet_FINAL_V2.xlsx dataset has been fully replaced by this SkiEssentials 2027 Ski Test dataset. The original data is preserved in local/backup-final-v2/ (not deployed to GitHub Pages).
